messages:
alex: Quick async check for the quarterly milestone batch — can everyone drop a one-line status (Ship / Slip / Partial) + owner + top blocker by EOD? We need a short blurb for the postmortem and any cross-team deps.
priya: Payments V2 — Partial. Owner: priya. Core API shipped, UI flow slipped (design assets). Blocker: missing UX assets, ETA Mon.
marcus: Runtime routing — Ship. Owner: marcus. Canary rolled to 30%, latency looks stable. Autoscale tweak merged (PR #5234).
lina: Dedicated infra — Slip. Owner: lina. Vendor provisioning delayed, ETA ~2w. Raised INF-788.
dan: SDK & docs — Ship. Owner: dan. New JS/Go examples published. PRs: #6101, #6102. Minor follow-ups only.
alex: Thanks. @priya can you paste the UX ticket link? @lina any interim mitigation if vendor is late?
priya: UX ticket here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/UX-341. Designer says assets by Mon AM. Fallback: use default flow w/ note.
lina: Vendor says earliest next-week. Interim plan: spin a small 2-node pool in us-west if quota allows. I'll request quota today and attach vendor thread to INF-788.
marcus: FYI autoscale apply we used during canary:
```
kubectl apply -f deploy/autoscale-runtime.yaml
```
rolled during low-traffic window, no regressions.
dan: CR ping @alex @marcus — can you take a quick look at docs PR #6102? It's the example update for canary.
alex: On my list, will review by EOD. Product asked for 2–3 lines per owner about what helped or caused delays — please add to /Q4/retrospects.
priya: Will add 2 lines after design sync.
lina: Adding vendor timeline + mitigation notes to INF-788 now.
marcus: Dropping my retrospective notes too. Also opened BUG-900 for a small perf regression on long sequences; tracking but not blocking rollout.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: runtime/canary -> 30% at 2025-11-11T09:32:10Z :white_check_mark:
alex: Any unresolved cross-team deps before we close the quarter? @dan @priya
dan: One dependency — docs CI flakes intermittently, pinged eng-infra. Doesn't block publish but slows release.
priya: No other deps from product.
alex: Action items roundup:
- priya: secure UX assets by Mon or roll fallback
- lina: request quota & post vendor thread in INF-788
- marcus: monitor BUG-900 and update thread if it regresses
- dan: follow up with eng-infra on docs CI
- all: add 2–3 line retrospective notes to /Q4/retrospects by EOD Fri
Thanks all :thumbsup:
